in_hebrew.name: חננבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Hannibal is derived from the Hebrew words 'חנן' (chanan) which means grace, and 'אל' (el) which means God. The name Hannibal thus means 'God is gracious' or 'grace from God'.

in_greek.name: Χαννίβαλ
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Hannibal is derived from the Greek words 'χάννισκος' (channiskos) or 'χάννιβαλ' (channibal), which mean grace or mercy. The name Hannibal thus represents the idea of God's mercy or grace.

in_latin.name: Hannibal
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Hannibal is derived from the Latin word 'hannibalus', which means grace or mercy. The name Hannibal thus represents the idea of God's mercy or grace.
